name: ta.mfi
notes: Official v6 re-implementation uses math.sum windows, not Wilder smoothing: upper = sum(volume * (change(src) <= 0 ? 0 : src)), lower = sum(volume * (change(src) >= 0 ? 0 : src)), mfi = 100 - 100 / (1 + upper / lower). The na change on bar 0 adds volume * hlc3 to both windows (Pine v6 na comparisons are false).
